verdict.rationale: Expensify's own blog documents 'Ask Expensify AI Anything,' a built-in assistant that can create/categorize/approve expenses and even configure workspaces via plain language, matching the delegation story. However, this is first-party marketing copy with no independent hands-on corroboration, and community feedback in the pack focuses only on SmartScan's older categorization/data-handling issues rather than validating the AI assistant itself. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the AI assistant's task delegation, details on scope/limits of what it can autonomously do, and any user reports specifically about this AI feature.
